top_findings.title: [INITIALLY P0 BUT INVALIDATED] - Hard navigation to /admin/kitchen-display-system redirected to /kiosk/idle was a CONFOUND of session-loss (F04), not a separate routing bug
top_findings.evidence_initial: Repro 3 times in early audit: hard browser_navigate to /admin/kitchen-display-system → /kiosk/idle within 4s
top_findings.evidence_invalidating: Clean test isolation per advisor: Fresh login + ONE hard browser_navigate to /admin/kitchen-display-system + 6s wait = URL stays /admin/kitchen-display-system. Cookies = [XSRF-TOKEN] only (Sanctum stateful uses session cookie that may be opaque/missing in this driver). The earlier redirects all happened AFTER 3-4 prior navigations that exhausted the session.
top_findings.downgrade_reason: Per advisor: 'Every time you hit KDS via hard-nav and got redirected, you'd just done multiple prior navigations. You never isolated fresh session + single hard-nav as a clean test.' Once isolated: KDS loads cleanly via hard-nav. So this is the same root cause as F04 (session instability) not a separate routing bug.

top_findings.title: Silent HTML Masquerade pattern observed on /api/admin/v1/me
top_findings.evidence: fetch('/api/admin/v1/me') returned 200 HTML (SPA shell) instead of 404 JSON or 200 user JSON. routes/api.php doesn't have v1/me; SPA catch-all in routes/web.php:62 swallows the request.
top_findings.impact: Frontend code calling missing/typo'd API endpoints gets HTML which breaks JSON.parse silently. Already documented pattern in MEMORY.md.
top_findings.recommendation: Already known. Add explicit 404 fallback for /api/* before web catch-all in routes/web.php

top_findings.title: Admin role missing 3 critical permissions: cash-overview, ingredients, stock-rupture
top_findings.evidence: tinker verified: User('admin@lecayenne.fr')->can('cash-overview')==false, ->can('ingredients')==false, ->can('stock-rupture')==false. Other 7 perms (dashboard, pos, kitchen-display-system, order-status-screen, items, cash-sessions-report, pos-orders) = true.
top_findings.impact: Admin cannot reach cash overview dashboard, ingredients management, or stock rupture monitoring from admin nav. 3/10 audit pages unreachable.
top_findings.recommendation: V1.0.2 backlog per MEMORY.md. Update database/seeders/PermissionSeeder.php to grant these to Admin role.

top_findings.title: Session instability during rapid Playwright navigation - Sanctum cookie intermittently lost after ~3-4 navigations
top_findings.evidence: After 3-4 navigations across admin SPA, document.cookie only contains XSRF-TOKEN, no session cookie. Forced re-login via /login each time.
top_findings.impact: Test automation reliability only (humans don't navigate that fast). Not a production issue.
top_findings.recommendation: Investigate Sanctum cookie SameSite/lifetime in dev env. Add Playwright wait_for_response on /sanctum/csrf-cookie before SPA navigation.

verdict_explanation: Successfully audited 6/10 admin pages (with stretch-test on /admin/sales-report for HEAL-3 PDF EOD discovery = 7th page) with 213+ buttons inventoried, 149+ visible across pages, 3 click-tested with PASS results (Encaisser → modal, Historique → drawer, Exporter → PDF menu), 0 broken buttons, 0 console errors on tested critical buttons. HEAL-3 PDF EOD button LOCATED at /admin/sales-report Exporter dropdown (PDF menu item). UX quality EXCELLENT. The mission 'vraiment toutes les boutons' is technically NOT 100% honored because: (a) 3/10 pages blocked by V1.0.2 backlog permission gap (cash-overview, ingredients, stock-rupture) - already documented backlog, (b) 1/10 pages (OSS) is by-design buttonless customer display, (c) per-row CRUD buttons on items/pos-orders were inventoried but not click-tested (each click = page mutation risk). Initial P0 SPA-routing claim was INVALIDATED by clean discriminator test (advisor-suggested) - actual root cause is session instability under rapid nav (F04). RECOMMEND: reseed admin permissions, fix session stability for test automation.
